claims.claim: Container drums / water storage drums / plastic barrel / plastic drum and kegs
claims.evidence: Witness observed multiple blue plastic barrels/containers stacked outdoors.
No clear brand label or markings visible; witness did not report any food-grade certification/mark.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Witness did not report usage history; condition details like cracks/UV damage/leak status were not clearly visible.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: Witness noted some lids appear loose or partially placed and did not confirm leak/crack status.
Witness saw lids/cover tops but also noted some lids appear loose/partially placed; completeness and fit not confirmed.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume unknown (litres), which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the barrel capacity marking (litres) or a tape-measure/size reference with the full barrel dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case assumption of smaller/unknown capacity and treated as generic water-storage barrels.

risks.risk: Food-grade vs chemical-grade not confirmed; could be unsafe for drinking water.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of any embossed/printed markings (e.g., food-grade/NSF/brand) or a receipt/spec sheet stating food-grade material.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified/possibly non-food-grade storage (worst-case for drinking-water use).

risks.risk: Leak/crack/warping/UV damage not confirmed; witness only noted lid fit concerns.
risks.proof: Short video clip of a water-fill test (or leak test) and close-ups of the entire barrel for cracks, dents, warping, and UV brittleness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/possible sealing risk (worst-case: treat as not proven leak-free).

risks.risk: Lid tightness and sealing integrity uncertain; some lids appear loose/partially placed.
risks.proof: Clip showing the lid fully seated and locked (if there is a locking mechanism) plus a seal/gasket close-up (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case with uncertain lid sealing (may require replacement/extra sealing).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/fittings (tap/spigot/bung/seals) could reduce usability and value.
risks.proof: Photos showing the top and bottom fittings (tap/spigot/bung), including whether any seals/gaskets are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as barrels only, with no guaranteed fittings/accessories.

risks.risk: Quantity/condition variability across the stack not confirmed (some barrels may be worse).
risks.proof: A count photo of all barrels plus individual close-ups of at least the worst-looking ones (cracks/dents/lid condition).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case condition among the set.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any embossed/printed markings on the barrels (brand, model, food-grade/grade, capacity in litres).
Provide a photo showing the full barrel dimensions or a capacity label (litres).
Send a short video showing the lid fully seated/locked and a close-up of the lid seal/gasket (if any).
Provide a leak test clip (fill with water briefly and show no seepage) or show the barrels after a water test.
Show whether there are any fittings/accessories (tap/spigot/bung/seals) and confirm what is included.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type (plastic water storage barrels), but key pricing drivers—capacity, food-grade status, and leak/condition proof—are not verifiable from the reported observations. Without those, any price would be too uncertain.
